Done. I've implemented all three functions:

- **`clamp`** in `src/num.js`: constrains a value to [min, max]
- **`formatBytes`** in `src/util.js`: formats bytes using B/KB/MB/GB with one decimal place
- **`slugify`** in `src/text.js`: converts titles to URL-friendly slugs (lowercase, trim, space→dash, strip non-alphanumeric)

All are exported and documented in CHANGELOG.md.
